ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated at the trailing edge margins and a central focal cluster.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across both lobes. Distinct dark, roughly circular bilobed cluster at the center adjacent to the median notch. Small, low-intensity circular focal spots localized on the distal third of the right lobe surface. Continuous dark banding along the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle approximately 38 degrees with a moderate vertical depth relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge, exhibiting a jagged, irregular saw-tooth pixel pattern isolated from the blue water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a convex sweep transitioning into a forward-curling, hooked tip. Right lobe displays a more uniform convex sweep towards a tapered distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least six roughly circular, dark-pixel clusters on the ventral surface of the right lobe, consistent with localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions located on the mid-section of the left lobe, intersecting the primary pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, dark, high-contrast pigmentation anomaly or scar cluster localized at the central insertion point of the flukes near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tip of the left lobe displays a significant upward/forward curl with high-contrast black-and-white mottling, creating a unique structural profile.
